headline: Missile Command learned to shoot back
lede: Batch 29 of the WATCH rollout seats a sweep-proven gunner on Missile Command: press Y and every warhead dies high, with not one city lost across a hundred seeded raids.

notes.text: The title had never driven itself — the whole tick lifted into sim.js (no wall clock anywhere), and gunnerStep became the first brain it ever had: intercept HIGH (above every blast's reach), urgent-first, exactly one promised ABM per warhead.

Certified the b27 way: every seed in the sweep clears waves 1-5 with all six cities AND all three silos standing, spending 79.8 shots against 80 warheads. Deepest run hit wave 12 — past wave 11 the arithmetic (32 warheads vs 30 shells) is the honest wall, and the README says so.

First consumer of RotateHint's published attribute: this 4:3 letterbox was the first attract-pill collision, so the centered WATCH chrome now steps aside behind the rotate card, and the phone suite clears the card like a player before driving the pill.
